actualCoverage.readMethod: Read all 34 Chinese/Japanese blocks and all 12 notes; reread middle blocks 12–21 separately after display truncation and final blocks 22–33. changes.before: 僕は死んでお詫びするところだ
changes.after: 僕は死んでも仕方がないよ
changes.reason: 我就该死了 is an extravagant declaration of deserving death, not a promise to die in apology to an added recipient.

changes.before: もう一言、言ってから行ってくれ
changes.after: 僕がもう一言話すまで、行かないでくれ
changes.reason: 我说一句话再走: Baoyu wants to speak before Daiyu leaves; previous Japanese could ask Daiyu to speak.

changes.before: まったく、おっしゃってくださいな
changes.after: まったく、どういうおつもりでしょうね
changes.reason: 倒是你说说罢 is conversational agreement with Baochai about the visitor, rather than a literal request to speak.

Shoes one pair, ten butterfly knots, third watch, silver fifty liang, two sets of clothes and two attendants retained.
Baochai consolation retains two sighs and unsentimental words; Wang account of broken property and Baochai accident hypothesis remain their statements, not narrator fact.
